place: Kavaratti Island Capital and Marine Aquarium
text:
Kavaratti (, Malayalam: [kɐʋɐɾɐt̪ːi]) is an atoll in the Indian Union Territory of Lakshadweep. The census town of Kavaratti, which is the major settlement in the atoll, serves as the capital of Lakshadweep. It is located about 360 km (220 mi) west of the Malabar coast in mainland India.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Lakshadweep, formerly the Laccadives, is a group of islands 200–440 km (120–270 mi) off India's southwestern coast in the Arabian Sea. They are India's only coral atolls and geologically a part of the same chain as the Maldives.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
